verdict.rationale: Box documents a first-party Chunked Upload API that reliably uploads large files by splitting them into parts that can be uploaded individually, which covers the core of the story. The pack does not explicitly document upload sessions, resuming after a dropped connection, or retrying individual failed parts. missing for 10: explicit upload-session lifecycle docs, documented resume/retry behavior after connection loss, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, big files upload reliably — documented chunked/resumable upload sessions that survive a dropped connection

citations.quote: The Chunked Upload API provides a way to reliably upload large files to Box by chunking them into a sequence of parts that can be uploaded individually.
